verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm offering legal services such as transactions, funds, notary work and transparency-register filings, not a software or API product, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a category error for this kind of offering. Its mentions of legal tech and a software-supported unit do not show it ships any public API. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
